title: FAQ: Bluest Account
summary: This “FAQ: Bluest Account” document covers Bluest’s complimentary personal check orders (3 per year), safe deposit box rental discount (75.0%), and the returned deposit fee ($0.00). It also explains how to order additional checks after the free 3 and how the safe deposit box discount is applied when opening or renewing a rental.
